senses.gloss:
शेव् शेव् (another form of rt. सेव्), cl. 1.
A. शेवते, &c., to worship, serve.

सेव् सेव् (thought to be connected with
rt. सप्), cl. 1. A. सेवते (sometimes also
P. सेवति), सिषेवे, सेविष्यते, असेविष्ट, सेवितुम्,
to follow, go after, seek, pursue; to wait upon, serve,
honour, obey, worship, gratify; to love, attend to,
devote or apply one's self to, cultivate, study, prac-
tise, perform, do; to use, enjoy; to enjoy (sexually);
to frequent, dwell in, inhabit; to watch over, protect,
guard: Pass. सेव्यते, to be followed or served, &c.:
Caus. सेवयति, -यितुम्, Aor. असिषेवत्, to serve,
honour, worship: Desid. सिसेविषते, -ति: Intens.
सेषेव्यते; [cf. Gr. σέβομαι; perhaps Goth. sai-
vala, ‘soul;’ Old Germ. sela.]

शेव शेव, अस्, आ, अम् (according to Uṇādi-s.
I. 152, 154. fr. rt. 1. शी, but more probably con-
nected with rt. श्वि and शवस्, cf. शिव), causing
happiness, propitious, affectionate (Ved., Sāy. = सु-
ख-कर); (अस्), m. a snake; height, elevation;
happiness; treasure, wealth; an epithet of Agni (as
being the source of happiness, Sāy. = सुख-कर);
of Soma; the male organ, = शेप; (अम्), n. happi-
ness; (अम्), ind. hail, homage, an exclamation or
salutation addressed to the deities; (अम्, आ), n. f.
the male organ, penis (= शेप).
—शेव-धि, इस्, m.
(also written सेव-धि), ‘wealth-receptacle,’ one of
the nine treasures of Kuvera, divine treasure, any
valuable treasure; [cf. नि-धि.]
—शेवधि-पा, आस्,
m., Ved. a lord of treasures.

सेवा, f. service, attendance, servitude; worship,
homage; devotion or addiction to; use, practice,
employment; resorting to, frequenting.
—सेवा-काकु,
उस्, f. change of voice in service (i. e. sometimes
speaking loudly, sometimes softly, sometimes angrily,
sometimes sorrowfully).
—सेवा-धर्म, अस्, m. the
duty or rule of service; the functions or obligations
of service.
—सेवा-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, maintaining service,
doing service, serving.
—सेवावलम्ब (˚वा-अव्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, depending on the service of another.
—सेवा-व्यवहार, अस्, m. the practice of service.

शे-वृध्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. conferring happiness, (Sāy.
शे-वृधः = शेवस्य, सुखस्य वर्धयितारः,
Ṛg-veda V. 87, 4.)
शेवृध् शे-वृध्, शे-वृध. See col. 2.

शे-वृध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. increasing or con-
tributing to felicity, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda III. 16, 2.
appears to derive शे-वृध fr. 2. शम् and rt.
वृध्); (अम्), n. happiness (enumerated among the
सुख-नामानि in Naigh. III. 6).

शेव्य, अस्, m., Ved. a giver of happiness, (Sāy.
= साधुः सुख-कर्ता, Ṛg-veda I. 156, 1.)

सेव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be served or obeyed, to be
worshipped or honoured, honourable; to be prac-
tised, to be used or employed or enjoyed; to be
taken care of or guarded; (अस्), m. the Aśvattha tree;
the Hijjala plant; (आ), f. the parasitical plant Vandā;
(अम्), n. the root of Andropogon Muricatus.
—से-
व्य-ता, f. or सेव्य-त्व, अम्, n. the condition of
being worthy of honour, honourableness, rank, emi-
nence, worth.
—सेव्य-सेवक, औ, m. du. served
and server, master and servant.

शेवल शेवल, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt.
1. शी, cf. शैवल), the aquatic plant Vallisneria
[]
Octandra [cf. शेपाल]; the green moss-like sub-
stance growing on the surface of stagnant water,
duck-weed, (said to be also अस्, m.)
शेवाल, अम्, n. = शेवल above.
शेवलिनी, f. ‘having Śevala,’ a river; [cf. शैवलिन्.]
शेवाली, f. a kind of plant (= आकाश-मांसी).
सेवन. See under 2. सेवक.

1. सेवन, अम्, n. (for 2. see col. 2), the act of
following, serving, service; devotion or addiction to,
being fond of, fondness for, using, practising, adopt-
ing, enjoying; carnal enjoyment; frequenting, dwell-
ing in.

2. सेवन, अम्, n. (for 1. see col. 1), the act of
sewing, darning, stitching (= सीवन); a sack; (ई),
f. a needle; a seam; (in anatomy) a suture or pecu-
liar seam-like union of parts (of which there are
seven in the body, viz. the five sutures of the cranium,
the frenum of the tongue, and that of the glans
penis).

सेवित्वा, ind. having sewn or stitched; having
joined.

1. सेवक, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 2. see col. 2), serv-
ing, waiting or attending upon, worshipping; prac-
tising; servile, dependent; (अस्), m. a servant, at-
tendant; a worshipper, votary.
—सेवकोत्तम (˚क-
उत्˚), अस्, आ, m. f. best of servants.

सेवक 2. सेवक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. सिव्; for 1.
सेवक see col. 1), one that sews, a sewer; a sack.

1. सेवनीय, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see col. 2), to
be followed; to be practised; to be served or waited
on, to be honoured.

2. सेवनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, (for 1. see col. 1), to be
sewn or stitched together.

सेवमान, अस्, आ, अम्, following, pursuing, serv-
ing, attending on; practising, being addicted to, using,
employing, &c.

सेवि, n. (according to Śabda-k.) the jujube (=
बदर); an apple (in this sense probably fr. Per-
sian सेब्).
सेविका, f. a kind of sweetmeat.

सेवित, अस्, आ, अम्, followed, pursued; served, at-
tended on, obeyed, honoured, worshipped, adored;
protected, preserved; practised, used; infested or
frequented by; (अम्), n. the jujube (= बदर);
an apple (= सेवि).
—सेवित-मन्मथ, अस्, आ, अम्,
addicted to love or amorous enjoyments.
सेवितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, = 1. सेवनीय.

सेवितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, serving, worshipping; a ser-
vant, attendant, worshipper; addicted or devoted to.

सेविन्, ई, इनी, इ, following, pursuing, serving, obey-
ing, honouring; practising, using; dwelling in, fre-
quenting; (ई), m. a servant.
—सेवि-त्व, अम्, n.
service, obedience, devotion; the state of one who
dwells in or inhabits.

सेव्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being served or waited
on, being attended on.

सेवकालु सेवकालु, उस्, m. a kind of plant
(= निशा-भङ्गा, commonly called Dugdhapeyā).
सेवती सेवती, f. the Indian white rose.

सेवधि सेव-धि, इस्, m. (for शेव-धि, q. v.),
one of the nine treasures of Kuvera, a divine trea-
sure; a treasure.
